name: us1-style-ambiguous-refusal
description: US1 (FR-001/FR-002): the AMBI project's discovery payload carries neither `style` nor `simplified`. An unattended config run MUST fail closed with exit 4 (EXIT_CONFIG), write NOTHING (no config.local.yml, no extensions.yml, no README block), and name on stderr the project key, the missing signal, and the two valid --style values. stderr, exit code, and the (unchanged) workdir are byte-identical across ports (FR-020).
